pane.title: how keys work
pane.content:
The engine has a small set of ACTIONS:

  quit
  focus-next
  focus-prev

The "keybindings" block in this config maps keys onto them. Here we bound:

  h / left / ctrl+p  ->  focus-prev
  l / right / ctrl+n ->  focus-next
  q / ctrl+c         ->  quit  (defaults)

Any key NOT claimed globally is handed to the focused pane. The scrollable
widgets accept:

  j / k        line down / up
  arrows       line down / up
  pgdn / pgup  page down / up
  space / f    page down
  b            page up
  g / home     jump to top

Focus this pane and scroll — the
border colour marks who has focus.

pane.title: pane 3
pane.content:
Focus cycles through panes in the order they appear in the layout tree:

  1  how keys work
  2  long text
  3  this pane
  4  live keys

focus-next past the last pane wraps to the first; focus-prev past the first wraps to the last.
